resale_co.how_to_apply: No Borough resale Certificate of Occupancy. The only Borough document needed for the sale of a home is the smoke detector / carbon monoxide re-sale certification (see fire certificate).

evidence.quote: ** Please note: this is the only document the Borough of Mountainside requires for sale of a home - we do not perform CO Inspections
Ms. Deanna Andre Technical Assistant to the Construction Official 908-232-2919

resale_co.notes: The Borough's Building/Zoning/Engineering page says the smoke detector re-sale certification is the only document the Borough requires for the sale of a home and that it does not perform CO (Certificate of Occupancy) inspections. Contact emails are taken from the mailto links on that page (Jerry Eger: jeger@mountainside-nj.com; Deanna Andre: dandre@mountainside-nj.com).

requirements: Smoke alarm on each level and outside each separate sleeping area
Battery-only smoke alarms must be 10-year sealed battery units (listed to ANSI/UL 217); hardwired alarms from original construction or rehabilitation may not be replaced with battery alarms
Carbon monoxide alarm in the immediate vicinity of the sleeping areas (battery, hardwired or plug-in)

Portable fire extinguisher within 10 feet of the kitchen, listed and labeled, rated at least 2A-10B:C and no more than 10 pounds (still listed on the Borough page as of October 2026, although the state dropped it from the sale certificate in February 2025)

authorities.name: Borough of Mountainside Construction Department, Smoke Detector Re-Sale Certification (fire code enforcing agency: Scotch Plains Township under a shared service)
authorities.lead_time: After the fee is paid and the online form is submitted, the Borough sends an inspection date. Inspections are Tuesday 3 to 6 pm and Thursday 1:30 to 4:30 pm.

fees.label: Smoke detector, carbon monoxide alarm and portable fire extinguisher re-sale certification (residential)
fees.quote: Once you have paid the $100.00 fee, completed and submitted the form you will be notified with an inspection date.

authorities.how_to_apply: Request the inspection online through the SDL Portal (www.sdlportal.com, Mountainside), pay the $100.00 fee and submit the form; the Borough then gives an inspection date. For online payment help call the construction office at 908.232.2919.
authorities.contact_title: Construction Official (Technical Assistant: Ms. Deanna Andre, dandre@mountainside-nj.com)

evidence.quote: SMOKE DETECTOR RE-SALE/RE-LEASING CERTIFICATION (RESIDENTIAL ONLY) Smoke Detector/Carbon Monoxide and Portable Fire Extinguisher inspection requests can be made online through the SDL Portal.
Once you have paid the $100.00 fee, completed and submitted the form you will be notified with an inspection date. Inspections take place: Tuesday, 3 to 6pm and Thursday, 1:30 to 4:30pm
A portable fire extinguisher shall be within 10 feet of the kitchen and shall be an approved listed and labeled type with a minimum rating of 2A-10B:C and no more than 10 pounds.
Requests for online payments must be made through the construction office by calling 908.232.2919.
Scotch Plains Township is the LEA for Mountainside Borough.
Mountainside Borough2010 LEAID: 2010-001 Enf Auth. Fire Dept Fire Official Rutland B Paal Jr Phone (908) 232-6700 Email spaal@scotchplainsnj.com Scotch Plains Inspections Dept

fire_cert.notes: The Borough's own page runs the resale smoke/CO certification through its Construction Department and the SDL Portal for a $100.00 fee. The NJ DCA LEA registry (July 2026) says Scotch Plains Township is the fire code enforcing agency for Mountainside, and the state fire directory lists Scotch Plains fire official Rutland B Paal Jr (spaal@scotchplainsnj.com) for Mountainside, with phone (908) 232-6700 on one line and (908) 322-6700 on the smoke detector compliance line; the Borough office (908-232-2919) is the practical contact. The Borough page still lists a portable fire extinguisher, which state law (P.L.2025, c.19) removed from the sale certificate in February 2025; confirm with the office. No application form link is given apart from the SDL Portal (account sign-up required), so application_url is left blank.
